title: ADC characterization
line: SINAD, ENOB and SFDR of a 12-bit converter from one FFT.
description: A 12-bit ADC at 1 MS/s, characterized from a coherently sampled sine (IEEE 1241 style): SINAD, ENOB and SFDR from one FFT. The captured codes come from adc_capture at the end of the file.
thumbnailAlt: Output spectrum of a 12-bit ADC with its tone and third harmonic, rendered by RunMat
